item.title: Conservation groups split over Hochul’s plan to roll back parts of environmental law
item.description: Construction of Clinton Square Studios, a nearly $30 million mixed-use 67-unit affordable housing development in Albany, New York. The governor is proposing to exempt certain housing projects from the state's rigorous environmental review process. [ more › ]

item.title: Judge tells ICE to free man arrested in Chinatown sweep, warns of unconstitutional arrests
item.description: Officers descended on Chinatown in October. A judge freed one of the detainees. A federal judge said the immigration agency violated due process by ignoring its own rules and cautioned against 'post hoc' justifications for immigration detentions. [ more › ]

item.title: Compost your corpse? Brooklyn's Green-Wood Cemetery to make dying more green
item.description: Everyone turns to worm food eventually. A terramation service to be offered at Green-Wood Cemetery speeds up that process after death. The historic cemetery is running out of space for new graves, and plans to offer a more sustainable alternative to cremation or burials. [ more › ]

item.title: Medical examiner releases details on early storm deaths as NYC faces more ‘lethal’ temps
item.description: At least 17 people died last week due to cold exposure and temps are getting worse. Alcohol and drugs were a factor in four of five early deaths, according to the examiner. [ more › ]
